title: Cyber Resilience 2027: What Leaders Need to Know Now | World Economic Forum
gist: A thin podcast landing page for a World Economic Forum session (recorded 21 October) drawing on its Global Future Council on Cybersecurity. It frames cybersecurity as at a strategic inflection point, moving from a technical/compliance issue to a determinant of economic continuity, organizational resilience and global stability, and lists 2027 leadership priorities without detailing them.

insights.claim: The World Economic Forum argues cybersecurity has reached a strategic inflection point: it is no longer solely a technical or compliance issue but is becoming a critical determinant of economic continuity, organizational resilience and global stability.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Supports a view that cyber spend migrates from IT/compliance budgets to board-level resilience budgets, broadening the demand base for security vendors.
insights.quote: Cybersecurity has reached a strategic inflection point. No longer solely a technical or compliance issue, it is becoming a critical determinant of economic continuity, organizational resilience and global stability.
insights.locator: Cybersecurity has reached a strategic inflection point

insights.claim: The World Economic Forum's Global Future Council on Cybersecurity frames cybersecurity as a value-creating investment for organizations rather than purely a cost.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: If boards adopt the value-creation framing, cyber budgets become less cyclical and less vulnerable to cost-cutting.
insights.quote: treat cybersecurity as a value-creating investment
insights.locator: Drawing on insights from the World Economic Forum’s Global Future Council

insights.claim: The World Economic Forum's Global Future Council on Cybersecurity identifies building a common language around cyber risk and strengthening resilience mechanisms as leadership priorities for the 2027 cybersecurity agenda.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: A shared cyber-risk vocabulary points toward more standardized risk quantification and disclosure, relevant to cyber insurance and risk-rating providers.
insights.quote: build a common language around cyber risk
insights.locator: Drawing on insights from the World Economic Forum’s Global Future Council

insights.claim: The World Economic Forum's cybersecurity experts call for more coordinated action on cyber resilience across business and government heading into 2027.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Watch for public-private cyber frameworks and information-sharing mandates that could shape vendor demand and compliance requirements.
insights.locator: Drawing on insights from the World Economic Forum’s Global Future Council
